<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/dns-lookup/dns-intelligence/profiles"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Issues a single NATS request running every operation in `profiles` against `domain` under one deadline, and returns one result per operation. Answers are observations with typed evidence — there is no verdict and no score. Per-operation worker errors are returned as data; only transport, protocol, and whole-request failures map to non-2xx.
